svg.text: Crystal Lake Dam · spillways and stop logs, front elevation
Heights in stick feet. Winter setup (1 log) solid; summer logs dashed.
EAP pool · Winter, one extra stop log removed
EAP pool · Winter, normal stop logs
EAP pool · Summer, normal stop logs
EAP Lower Stop Logs · Lower stop logs 4"+
EAP Emergency Level 2 · Alert NORCOM · KCOEM · DSO
EAP · overtopping starts (low point E of bridge); close the bridge
EAP Emergency Level 3 · bridge deck overtopped
Vertical: to scale, in stick feet (the lake staff gauge). Horizontal: representative only; the left/right placement of the spillways is schematic.
Stop logs: laser-level survey 2026-11-25. Winter normal = 1 log (shown solid), summer normal = 2 logs (added logs dashed). Logs ~5″; main base boards 3½″.
EAP lines are the EAP's Water Level / Action Table (KI08-0195, rev. 2026-11) as written. Purple ticks: the model's overtopping levels (the stick-to-dam datum is not surveyed).
Opening tops are estimates: the main's is inferred from its rating; the aux's (bridge underside) depends on which sill its 2.5 ft was measured from.
